quests.name: Out of Hearthveil
quests.track: North arch into Cinderwood.
quests.text: North arch, through the Cinderwood. The far side opens the Salt Causeway.

quests.name: Across the salt
quests.track: Cross the Salt Causeway to the Spire.
quests.text: The white road runs to the Ruined Spire. Walk it to the far arch.

quests.name: Down the spire
quests.track: Find the way down to the Sunken Kiln.
quests.text: Search the Ruined Spire for the way into the Sunken Kiln.

quests.name: Under the kiln
quests.track: The Sunken Kiln ends at Veyra.
quests.text: The Sunken Kiln goes down to the Heart. Veyra tends the fire there.

quests.name: Stop Veyra
quests.track: Kill Veyra. Brinehollow opens after.
quests.text: Kill Veyra. When she falls, Brinehollow opens.

quests.name: Reach Brinehollow
quests.track: Go to Brinehollow. Ask Brin first.
quests.text: Use the gate and go to Brinehollow. Ask Brin before you touch a bell.
quests.warn: Ask Brin before you touch a bell.

quests.name: Through the reeds
quests.track: Cross Reed Marsh to the Mirror Flats.
quests.text: Pick your way through Reed Marsh. The Mirror Flats start where the water hardens.

quests.name: Over the glass
quests.track: Swing at the late copy on the Flats.
quests.text: Cross the Mirror Flats. Swing at the copy, not at yourself. The Archive is past it.
quests.warn: The late pair of boots is the one to hit.

quests.name: Out of the archive
quests.track: Leave the Archive for the caverns.
quests.text: The Drowned Archive still files the dead. The Bell Caverns are the way out.

quests.name: The wrapped bells
quests.track: Through the caverns. Don't toll.
quests.text: The Bell Caverns lead to the Queen Pool. Leave the bronze wrapped.

quests.name: Stop Morra
quests.track: Kill Morra. The orchard opens after.
quests.text: Kill Morra the Silt Queen. Vesper Orchard opens after.

quests.name: The orchard market
quests.track: Vesper Orchard. Buy steel, not apples.
quests.text: Go to Vesper Orchard. Vetch sells steel. Leave the red fruit.
quests.warn: The red fruit is not supper.

quests.name: Down the rows
quests.track: Walk the Briar Rows to the Sap Press.
quests.text: Walk the Briar Rows. The Sap Press is at the far end, still turning.

quests.name: Past the press
quests.track: Past the press, into the Galleries.
quests.text: The screw still turns. Get past it and into the Hush Galleries.

quests.name: Under the frames
quests.track: Cross the Galleries to the Root Nave.
quests.text: The faces are gone from the paintings. The Root Nave is under the rooms.

quests.name: Up the nave
quests.track: The Root Nave leads up to Sallow.
quests.text: The nave grew its own roof. Heartwood is at the end, and Sallow with it.

quests.name: Stop Sallow
quests.track: Kill Sallow. Ashgate opens after.
quests.text: Kill Sallow the Root King. Ashgate and the Pale Stair open after.

quests.name: The last warm door
quests.track: Ashgate, then the Pale Steps.
quests.text: Go to Ashgate. Rook keeps the stall. The stair starts at the Pale Steps.

quests.name: The pale steps
quests.track: Climb the Pale Steps to the Tombs.
quests.text: Climb the Pale Steps. The wind has teeth. The Ember Tombs are at the top.

quests.name: The warm graves
quests.track: The Tombs open onto the Quiet Fields.
quests.text: The graves still give heat. Cross the Ember Tombs onto the Quiet Fields.

quests.name: The quiet fields
quests.track: Cross the Fields to the Stair of Names.
quests.text: Nothing grew back here. The Stair of Names is cut into the far side.

quests.name: Don't add yours
quests.track: The Stair ends at the First Kiln.
quests.text: Climb the Stair of Names. The First Kiln is the fire they have been feeding.

quests.name: Bank the fire
quests.track: Kill Mael. The rift stone is warm after.
quests.text: Kill Mael the Unbanked. If the kiln goes quiet, the march is over. The rift stone in Ashgate is warm after.

bargains.name: Ash Bargain
bargains.text: The kiln takes a little life and gives the fire back.

bargains.name: Quiet Glass
bargains.text: The glass steadies your mana and your cold ward.

bargains.name: Sweet Sap
bargains.text: The sap sticks. You bleed slower, and so do they.

bargains.name: Uncut Name
bargains.text: A name that was never cut. Finds come easier. Resists don't.

zones.name: Hearthveil
zones.blurb: A walled refuge where the public kiln still eats scrap wood.

zones.name: Cinderwood

named.name: Old Knot
named.line: The hound that sits on the town path and will not move.

zones.blurb: Black trees and moths that die in a puff of coals.

zones.name: Salt Causeway

named.name: Glass Aunt
named.line: She slings at anyone on the white road. Do not wave.

zones.blurb: A pale road of salt crust and broken glass.

zones.name: Ruined Spire
zones.blurb: Stairs that forgot which way was up.

zones.name: Sunken Kiln
zones.blurb: Brick, slag, and things that still think the fire is a god.

zones.name: Heart of the Kiln
zones.blurb: The fire at the bottom of the old city.

zones.name: Brinehollow
zones.blurb: A stilt village where the lamps burn fish oil and the bells are kept wrapped.

zones.name: Reed Marsh

named.name: The Still Lurker
named.line: If the reeds stop moving, it is already there.

zones.blurb: Black water and reeds tall enough to hide a lurker.

zones.name: Mirror Flats
zones.blurb: A sheet of broken mirror. Things walk on both sides of it.

zones.name: Drowned Archive
zones.blurb: Shelves gone soft. The shades still file the dead.

zones.name: Bell Caverns
zones.blurb: Bells hung in the wet dark, wrapped so they will not ring.

zones.name: Queen Pool
zones.blurb: The pool under the wrapped dark.

zones.name: Vesper Orchard
zones.blurb: A market under black fruit trees. The lamps are hooded so the moths stay out.

zones.name: Briar Rows

named.name: Row Warden
named.line: Same row, every dusk. Step off it.

zones.blurb: Straight rows of briar tall enough to hide a stag.

zones.name: Sap Press
zones.blurb: The screw still turns. The sap that comes out is the wrong red.

zones.name: Hush Galleries
zones.blurb: Long rooms. The paintings have had their faces taken.

zones.name: Root Nave
zones.blurb: Pews of root, and a nave that grew its own roof.

zones.name: Heartwood
zones.blurb: Where the first cut still argues.

zones.name: Ashgate
zones.blurb: The last warm door under the pale stair. The kiln smoke still reaches this high.

zones.name: Pale Steps

named.name: Pale Mother
named.line: The stair keeps her instead of a watch.

zones.blurb: Switchbacks cut into pale stone. The wind has teeth.

zones.name: Ember Tombs
zones.blurb: Graves that still give heat. The names on them are worn smooth.

zones.name: Quiet Fields
zones.blurb: Open ground where the ash fell and nothing grew back.

zones.name: Stair of Names
zones.blurb: A stair cut with other people's names.

zones.name: The First Kiln
zones.blurb: The fire under all the other fires.

runewords.name: Reedwalk
runewords.flavor: A path written in reed-water. The boots remember the way across.

runewords.name: Briarbind
runewords.flavor: Bound with living thorn. It holds, and it resents being held.

runewords.name: Siltward
runewords.flavor: A ward that settled like silt. Slow to rise, harder to wash off.

runewords.name: Lantern Oath
runewords.flavor: Sworn under a coal lamp. The light went out. The oath did not.

runewords.name: Rootking
runewords.flavor: A name the orchard would rather you did not speak into steel.

runewords.name: Saltedge
runewords.flavor: Two runes, one edge. Made for someone who would not stand still.

runewords.name: Bellnote
runewords.flavor: The note stays in the steel after you stop singing.

runewords.name: Palestep
runewords.flavor: Armor that learned the stair. It is lighter on the way down.

runewords.name: Maelbank
runewords.flavor: A word for putting the fire back to sleep. It works better in a blade than in a prayer.

runewords.name: Emberwake
runewords.flavor: Two runes and the fire sits up. Kindle comes easier after that.

runewords.name: Stillchord
runewords.flavor: The hymn stays in the cloth. The room slows down around whoever wears it.

hirelings.name: Quill
hirelings.title: Lantern scout
hirelings.blurb: A quiet archer with a coal lamp. The lamp steadies your eye and your breath.

difficulties.name: Banked Fire
difficulties.about: The first telling. Monster numbers are the ones on the road signs.

difficulties.name: Kindled
difficulties.about: The second walk, after Veyra. Hits land harder than the level bump, and every resist gives up 18.

difficulties.name: White Ash
difficulties.about: After Morra. The ash has gone pale. Hits land harder than Kindled, life is higher, and every resist gives up 32.

mapAffixes.name: Ash Wind
mapAffixes.text: Your resists give up a share.

mapAffixes.name: Bright Finds
mapAffixes.text: The drops are kinder. The packs are a little tougher.

mapAffixes.name: Swarm
mapAffixes.text: More of them. Each one is a bit thinner.

mapAffixes.name: Named Ground
mapAffixes.text: More champions and elites. They pay for the trouble.

mapAffixes.name: Hexed Air
mapAffixes.text: Your resists fall harder. The finds are richer.

mapAffixes.name: Brutal Packs
mapAffixes.text: Elites carry one more name. The ground pays for it.

cinderwood.name: Old Knot
cinderwood.line: The hound that sits on the town path and will not move.

salt_causeway.name: Glass Aunt
salt_causeway.line: She slings at anyone on the white road. Do not wave.

ruined_spire.name: Stair Captain
ruined_spire.line: Still walking the broken watch. The armor is louder than he is.

sunken_kiln.name: Kiln Heart
sunken_kiln.line: A golem that thinks it is the fire. It is not. It is close.

reed_marsh.name: The Still Lurker
reed_marsh.line: If the reeds stop moving, it is already there.

mirror_flats.name: Second Lantern
mirror_flats.line: The light on its back is not yours. Do not follow it.

drowned_archive.name: Head Archivist
drowned_archive.line: It files the living under the dead if you stand still.

bell_caverns.name: Wrapped Novice
bell_caverns.line: The only one who still wants the bells to ring.

briar_rows.name: Row Warden
briar_rows.line: Same row, every dusk. Step off it.

sap_press.name: The Screw
sap_press.line: It pushes until something gives. Do not be the something.

hush_galleries.name: Frame Moth
hush_galleries.line: It nests in the pictures with the faces scraped off.

root_nave.name: First Pew
root_nave.line: The bench grew legs. It still thinks you should sit.

pale_steps.name: Pale Mother
pale_steps.line: The stair keeps her instead of a watch.

ember_tombs.name: Warm Grave
ember_tombs.line: The stone is hot. So is what is walking out of it.

quiet_fields.name: Ash Kite
quiet_fields.line: Nothing grows here. That one still hunts.

stair_of_names.name: Unwritten
stair_of_names.line: Your name is not on the step yet. Keep it that way.

strength.title: Strength
strength.text: Strength: +1% damage per point with strength weapons, needed for heavy armor.

dexterity.title: Dexterity
dexterity.text: Dexterity: attack rating for each point, a little crit and defense, needed for bows and light blades.

vitality.title: Vitality
vitality.text: Vitality: life for each point. How much depends on your class.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: Energy: mana for each point, plus a little mana each second.

damage.title: Damage
damage.text: Damage: the weapon swing, raised by strength and enhanced damage. The high number is the hard hit.

defense.title: Defense
defense.text: Defense: weighed against attack rating. A higher number means more swings miss. Armor, level, and a little dexterity raise it.

attack.title: Attack rating
attack.text: Attack rating: weighed against defense to see if your swing lands.

resists.title: Resists
resists.text: Resists: fire, cold, lightning, then poison. Each point cuts that damage. They cap at 75% and can fall below zero.

mf.title: Magic find
mf.text: Magic find: better odds that a drop is magic, rare, set, or unique.

shrines.name: Fortune Shrine
shrines.text: The ash shows you brighter things.

veyra.enter: This fire is mine. The city went out. I did not.
veyra.death: Take the heat if you can hold it. I am done tending it.

morra.enter: You came close to my bell. I answer.
morra.death: I am going back under. Leave the bronze wrapped.

sallow.enter: You brought an axe into my nave. I remember the first one.
sallow.death: The rows may rest. I am finished arguing.

mael.enter: You fed me and called it sleep. I am awake.
mael.death: Bank the kiln. I have eaten enough.

bossAftermath.veyra: The floor will cool. Brinehollow is open. Ask Brin before you trust the water.
bossAftermath.morra: The roots kept going. Vesper is next. Buy steel there.
bossAftermath.sallow: The market can try the apples. Ashgate is the door under the pale stair.
bossAftermath.mael: Nobody has to feed the kiln tonight. The rift stone in Ashgate is warm, if you want a harder road.
